captions.text: Copying 73 stack-stable template files into the generated tree…

Frontend: building UsersPage with shadcn DataTable + AddEditDialog + DeleteAlertDialog…
Zod schemas mirror Pydantic — message parity locked verbatim.
TanStack Query hooks: rest-args forwarding for v5.20 4-arg signature.
